optimize.title: Normalize live state, snapshot purchased facts
optimize.label: Data model
optimize.body: Separate product, variant, inventory and order lines. Preserve historical price/address/SKU snapshots; avoid copying mutable product JSON into every cart item.

optimize.title: Protect stock inside PostgreSQL
optimize.label: Consistency
optimize.body: Lock one order, then balances in variant order. Conditional stock updates, reservation transitions and append-only movements commit together. Redis never decides inventory truth.

optimize.title: Put indexes behind real query shapes
optimize.label: Query plans
optimize.body: Review leading equality filters and stable sort keys. PK and UNIQUE already create supporting indexes. Referencing FK columns need an explicit access-path review; do not keep redundant indexes.

optimize.title: Keep the working set small
optimize.label: Partial indexes
optimize.body: Index held reservations and unresolved tasks with explicit stable predicates. Bind cutoff time in queries; do not put now() inside an index predicate.

optimize.title: Bound lists and batch relationships
optimize.label: API performance
optimize.body: Use keyset pagination for order/history queues. Fetch related order lines in bounded batches rather than one query per row. Limit bulk exports and stream them from a worker.

optimize.title: Measure before claiming a speedup
optimize.label: Validation
optimize.body: Compare EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on staging-sized data before/after an index. Record execution time, rows estimated/actual and buffer reads. No performance benchmark has been run for this proposed schema.

optimize.title: Maintain statistics and storage
optimize.label: Operations
optimize.body: Monitor autovacuum, dead tuples, table/index growth and pool saturation. Reassess hot-row contention before adding indexes. Partition append-only histories only when measured volume and retention justify it.

optimize.title: Cache published views, reconcile money
optimize.label: Read models
optimize.body: Cache public catalog/content with bounded TTL and outbox invalidation. Keep customer data private. Build dated rollups from financial facts and keep checkout/payment reads on the primary.

endpoints.description: name, email, password, acceptedTermsRevision → customer and verification challenge; never accepts role
email, password, remember, clientType → session, user and permissions or MFA challenge
Principal, permissions, expiresAt and browser CSRF token
